email.subject: Before Thursday: two shops that switched from Jobber

paragraphs.text: Thanks for Monday. You raised three things, and I'd like to answer them before the demo.

Switching in November. Copperwren Electric had the same worry. Their office manager closed out Friday on Jobber and opened Monday on Housecall Pro, with 1,400 customers and every open invoice moved over.
Cost. You're right that Jobber's entry plan now includes booking. On Thursday we'll price both for 15 techs with the tools you'd add, so you're comparing the same thing.
paragraphs.linkText: What Tallowbrook Plumbing pays for and uses

paragraphs.text: After-hours calls. Tallowbrook Plumbing in Phoenix added after-hours routing and online booking and now books 18% more jobs a month. Their owner is happy to talk with you, Dan. Want me to set that up this week?
Thursday, Sam will walk through a day-by-day switch plan for your shop and book a job after hours on your own calendar.
